dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged high-intensity perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped loops with sharp contrast gradients between the bright boundaries and darker interior regions, most prominent in the upper-left and central-left quadrants.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily localized along the lower-left margin and interspersed between the macro-annuli loops.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the upper-left field form an obtuse scalene triangle, with a fourth prominent centroid in the central field creating an irregular quadrilateral relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible vertical linear furrows and ridges on the distal flipper surface located at the bottom center of the image frame.
